svg.title: The workflow daneel brings
svg.desc: Five phases across three lanes. The owner asks, approves the batch, validates the design, publishes the release and decides the flow proposals. The agent files issues and proposes the batch. One run-batch invocation then asks every question first, loops run-entry over each Queued item to its merge on green, ends the batch, audits it and gives the closing brief. The harness holds the backlog and the Project, checks every push and lands a PR only on green checks and graded findings. The audit's proposals are filed as flow issues.
svg.text: The owner decides and publishes. The agent does the work. The harness proves it.
is never a file in git

Answers the questions the agent asks before the work starts
Validates the design mocks before anything visible is built
Validates no PR: the harness does
CI on every push: lint, types, tests, E2E, coverage floors
Reviewer lanes: each reviews a PR once, a critical fails its check
merge.py: lands a PR only on green checks and graded findings
one task end to end, to its merge on green
One run, a 3-hour budget; the same gate failing three times stops it.
